questions.question: For Modeled M&A Scenario Alpha, trace 3 hops from the acquisition scenario through target contracting parties and their SEC Exhibit 10 agreements to Change-of-Control consent triggers.
expected_answer_points: Target party PSiTech Corporation holds WEBSITE CONTENT LICENSE AGREEMENT with an annotated Change-of-Control clause
Requires pre-closing counterparty consent across the Portfolio Alpha contracts
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: The acquisition memo names target companies without quoting Exhibit 10 clauses; connecting Deal -> Party -> Contract -> Change-of-Control requires 3 hops.

questions.question: Trace 3 hops from Portfolio Acquisition Beta to identify which commercial agreements combine Anti-Assignment restrictions with IP License Grants.
expected_answer_points: Agreement CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT restricts assignment and carries an active license grant
Closing without assignment waivers risks IP license termination
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: Flat vector search retrieves isolated license paragraphs without tying them back through entity ownership to the carve-out perimeter.

questions.question: Which real agreements under Modeled M&A Scenario: Portfolio Roll-Up Acquisition Alpha carry an IP Ownership Assignment encumbrance, traced 3 hops from the deal scenario?
expected_answer_points: Contract ENDORSEMENT LICENSING AND CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT contains an expert-annotated IP Ownership Assignment clause
Acquiror must audit assigned foreground IP rights prior to signing
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: Deal memos and SEC Exhibit 10 IP assignment clauses reside in disjoint documents with no shared lexical overlap.

questions.question: Starting from the Change-of-Control clause node, traverse upstream 3 hops to list impacted commercial contracts, contracting parties, and M&A scenarios.
expected_answer_points: Reverse clause-to-deal traversal surfaces all affected contracts across Portfolio Alpha and Beta
Includes WEBSITE CONTENT LICENSE AGREEMENT and CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: Top-k semantic search on 'change of control' returns fragmented paragraphs and misses the reverse join back to deal-level exposure.

questions.question: Map the governing-law jurisdictions applicable to Portfolio Alpha's commercial contracts across a 3-hop Deal -> Party -> Contract -> Jurisdiction traversal.
expected_answer_points: Portfolio Alpha spans governing law California (CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT)
Also involves Nevada and California legal venues for consent disputes
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: Governing law clauses appear at the end of contracts with no mention of the portfolio acquisition grouping.
